title: Irish Toast
description: A simple and delicious breakfast or brunch dish made with toasted bread and irish bread, topped with lightly toasted bread.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add a small amount of oil to the pan and lightly toast the bread until golden brown.
Cube the irish bread into small pieces.
Add the torn toasted bread to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the crushed lightly toasted bread to the pan and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
